feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. The Integrator kept your iteration 4 controller and drivetrain exactly (base_speed 1.7, kp 2.5, kd 0.4, wheel_track 0.09, row at y=0.08 m), so the footprint is the only variable against iteration 4 (404.6). Evidence: iteration 4 gave 20 of 20 oval finishes and s-bend progress 0.486. Iteration 5 showed that wheel_track 0.08 m cut s-bend progress to 0.330, so 0.09 m stays. Iteration 6 showed that a 0.016 m footprint collapsed the oval to 0 of 20 (score 72.5), so a larger footprint is ruled out. Iteration 2 showed that a wider array raised oscillation to 0.37 and cut finishes, so the span stays. Slalom progress has held at 0.16 to 0.18 in iterations 1, 3, 4 and 5 with max_error near 0.06, which points away from track width and row position. Depending on the next race: if line_loss_events stay at or below about 0.95 per run and the oval keeps 20 of 20 with s-bend progress at or above 0.45, keep 0.008 m and test wheel_radius next, since speed is the remaining untested lever on the slalom. If line_loss_events rise above 1.0 per run or the oval drops below 17 finishes, the smaller footprint is missing bend-entry edges, so return to 0.012 m (the iteration 4 base) and test wheel_radius on that footprint.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events stay at or below about 0.95 per run and oval finishes hold at 20 of 20 with s-bend progress at or above 0.45, keep sensor_size 0.008 m and try wheel_radius 0.04 m. This is supported by iteration 4 (404.6, 20 of 20 at 0.012 m) and by the plateau of slalom progress at 0.16 to 0.18 across iterations 1, 3, 4 and 5, which does not respond to sensing or track width.

If line_loss_events rise above 1.0 per run or oval finishes fall below 17 of 20 with sensor_size 0.008 m, return sensor_size to 0.012 m (the iteration 4 value) and keep wheel_track 0.09 m. Iteration 6 (0.016 m) showed that changing the footprint in either direction can collapse the oval, so the change must be checked on the oval first.

If the slalom progress stays at about 0.17 to 0.18 with max_error near 0.06 under either footprint, try mass 0.5 kg with wheel_radius 0.035 m for faster yaw response. Iteration 5 showed that turn response, not track width alone, is what the s-bend depends on, and the slalom has not moved under any sensing or track change so far.
